Subject: Joint onboarding plan for Acme pilot — draft attached

Dana — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned while you loop in procurement/legal:

What we discussed (high level)
- Goal: 6-week pilot to validate editorial personalization with a 1M-token cap for the first phase.
- Success metrics: 30% CTR lift on recommended reads, latency under 350ms 95th percentile.

Draft Joint Plan (attached): Acme_MAP_v1.pdf — includes milestones, owners, and dependencies. Key milestones I put in the draft:
1) Kickoff & data ingestion (RWI: onboarding eng; Acme: data export) — target: 2026-06-22
2) Model fine-tune + internal evals (RWI lead: Karthik) — target: 2026-06-30
3) Integration + end-to-end smoke tests (Acme devs + RWI eng) — target: 2026-07-07
4) Pilot run & measurement (Acme analytics + RWI support) — target close / decision: 2026-07-15

Dependencies called out in the draft:
- Procurement/Purchase Order clearance for sandbox capacity (owner: Acme Procurement)
- Production API keys & VPC network rules (owner: Acme infra)
- Access to sample editorial dataset (owner: Acme content ops)

Ask / next steps:
- Please review the attached plan and mark any milestone date or owner changes inline.
- If procurement will delay the PO, tell us the expected clearance date so we can reforecast the pilot close.

I copied Marissa and Karthik for CS/engineering alignment. If this looks good, Marissa will update the plan and we can share a version for legal/procurement.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference

- For milestone (3) integration: we need a small staging window to validate VPC peering; recommend moving target to 2026-07-10.

- New target kickoff: 2026-07-12 (confirmed by procurement window)
- Adjusted milestones: Fine-tune complete by 2026-07-19; Integration + staging 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-26; Pilot measurement window 2026-07-27 to 2026-08-02
